events.description:
South African poet and novelist Mongane Wally Serote, born in 1944, was politically active against the apartheid regime. He was detained without trial and held in solitary confinement under the Terrorism Act. After earning an MFA at Columbia University on a Fulbright scholarship, he was barred from reentering South Africa, and he lived in exile in Botswana and London before returning to South Africa in 1990. A member of the African National Congress, he was elected to Parliament in the pivotal election of Nelson Mandela’s government in 1994.

Yorktown, Virginia, holds a familiar place in the history of the American Revolution: In the Siege of Yorktown in the fall of 1781, American and French forces helped to end the Revolutionary War and win American independence. Aaron Memmott captures the glow of cities at night, streetlights and wet pavement rendered in rich, atmospheric color. Patrick St. Clair turns to modernist interiors, where light becomes the bridge between the built world and the lives lived within it. Join us December 18th from 6–9 PM to experience new work by all three artists at Gallery MAR, Park City.

events.description:
Jan-Dec 2027 Individual Income (TC-40), Fiduciary (TC-41), Corporate Income (TC-20/TC-20S/TC-20MC) and Partnership Tax (TC-65) Due Date
You must file your return and pay any tax due:
1. by April 18, 2028, if you file on a calendar year basis (tax year ends Dec. 31, 2027); or
2. by the 15th day of the fourth month after the fiscal year ends, if you file on a fiscal year basis.
See form instructions for more information including extension requirements. Please refer to our forms page for downloadable instructions.
File (current individual income tax return only) or pay online using Taxpayer A
